name: walka-website
description: The website for Walka: static pages built with SvelteKit and hosted on GitHub Pages.

scripts.dev: npm run images && npm run tools && vite dev
scripts.build: npm run images && npm run tools && vite build
scripts.check: npm run images && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/estimates.test.ts tests/import.test.ts tests/usda.test.ts tests/stats.test.ts tests/csv.test.ts tests/common.test.ts tests/label.test.ts
